caption:
India just built the widest underground road tunnel on Earth. Guinness World Records made it official.

The Mumbai-Pune Expressway's new 13.3 km 'Missing Link' bypass, inaugurated May 1, 2026, includes twin tunnels certified by Guinness World Records as the widest underground road tunnel in the world at 22.33 metres. Built by Navayuga Engineering Company, the tunnels cut through the Sahyadri mountains, bypassing the Khandala Ghat bottleneck entirely. The bypass opened first to light vehicles and buses, with heavy trucks still on the old route pending a safety review.

Most highway upgrades widen a road. This one carved a world-record tunnel straight through a mountain range instead.
